page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 185 at right. Below it one column of running text, then a centred heading "EPIST. XVI.", a title line for the letter, and the italic greeting of the letter, which runs over several lines. Catchword "Ex" at the lower right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: gionis origine, vera esse existimo, Samaritanos quoque ubique ita appellari, si Judæos excipias, qui eos Chutheos semper appellant à Chutheis, qui in Israelitidum regionem à Salmanasero rege coloni transmissi sunt, ut constat ex 4 Reg. c. 17. sed videndus Josephus antiquit. Judaic. I. 9. c 14. & præterea lib. 11. cap 7. quæ enarrare urgente tabellario non vacat. Quæ exigit illustris dominatio tua in codicis sui commodatione, justissima sunt, res ipsa hoc postulat, sincere igitur & Christianæ me illa præstiturum, si libri tui commodatione me beaveris, ego polliceor. Parisiis pridie nonas Maij 1630.
main_text.head: EPIST. XVI.
Petrus à Valle J. Morino. Responsio ad præcedentem Epistolam, diversas in idem Argumentum cogitationes.

p.i: R. Patri atque eruditissimo Domino meo Patri Joanni Morino Congregationis Oratorii Presbytero Petrus à Valle Peregrinus. S.P.D.

page.notes: The printed page has a small mark (a vertical bar) between "eos" and "Chutheos" in the first paragraph; it is a printer's mark, not text, and was left out. The scan is faded and blurred at the right edge, where there is no printed text. The date line "1630." sits on its own line in the print and was kept in the same paragraph as the text before it.
